source.entry: unchanged V1 next trading day adjusted Open

methodology: Signals, states, support and entries are unchanged from V1.
ATR is calculated through signal date only.
Stop-first on ambiguous daily bars; stop gaps fill at Open; target gaps receive no improvement.
Unresolved trades exit at the 40th adjusted Close.
Drawdown uses non-overlapping equal-weight 40-session cohorts, not a capital portfolio.
